FN-SLJX477-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 174
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Senator Clyde Chambliss
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 02/25/2025
Senate Bill 174 as introduced would create the Business License Tax Reporting and Appeals
Act, which would expand the jurisdiction of the Alabama Tax Tribunal to include appeals of
business license tax determinations made by counties or municipalities. This could increase the
obligations of the Tribunal by an undetermined amount dependent upon the increase in the
number of hearings held by the Tribunal pursuant to this bill, and would simultaneously
decrease the administrative obligations of the Department of Revenue, also by an undetermined
amount dependent upon the respective decrease in the number of hearings no longer held
pursuant to the provisions of this bill. In addition, this bill would increase the administrative
obligations of local governments to submit annual reports to the Alabama Department of
Revenue.

FN-SLJX477-3
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 174
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Senator Clyde Chambliss
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 04/15/2025
Senate Bill 174 as passed the Senate would create the Business License Tax Reporting and
Appeals Act, which would expand the jurisdiction of the Alabama Tax Tribunal to include
appeals of business license tax determinations made by counties or municipalities, which could
increase the administrative obligations of the Tribunal for any additional hearings held by the
Tribunal pursuant to this bill and correspondingly decrease the administrative obligations of the
Department of Revenue for any hearings that otherwise would be held absent this bill but would
not be held pursuant to the provisions of this bill. In addition, this bill would increase the
administrative obligations of local governments to submit annual reports to the Alabama
Department of Revenue.
